title: Rotation Neglect for Daily Beaters
dataSources: StockX market prices (`stockx:price`), GOAT listings (`goat:listing`), Alias sales (`alias:sale`), sneaker rotation logs (`sneaker:rotation`), and deadstock age checks (`deadstock:age`).
app: StockX price alerts, GOAT listing exports, Alias seller settlement logs, sneaker rotation wear trackers, and deadstock age audits ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=sneaker:rotation silhouette=* days_since_wear=* wear_count=*
| where wear_count>=10 AND days_since_wear>30
| sort - days_since_wear
| table sku silhouette wear_count days_since_wear
description: Flags heavily worn daily beaters that have not been rotated in more than thirty days.
value: Even beaters need rest and cleaning cycles; neglect accelerates midsole collapse and odor buildup.
implementation: Log each wear with `days_since_wear` and review beaters with high `wear_count` monthly.
visualization: Table of neglected beaters by days since last wear.
grandmaExplanation: It counts everyday sneakers you have not rotated out in over a month.
